0.text: Diabetes management: Started metformin 1000 mg BID years ago. A1C remained around 6.9%. Recently added semaglutide (Ozempic) at low dose for appetite and glucose control. Noted improved appetite regulation and consistent fasting glucose (125-130 mg/dL). Blood pressure: Losartan 50 mg once daily; readings ~135-140/80-90 mmHg. Doctor recommends stress management and reduced sodium intake instead of increasing dosage. Taking daily magnesium supplement for potential blood pressure support. Hypothyroidism: Levothyroxine 75 mcg once daily, taken on empty stomach, 30 minutes before meals. Last TSH: 2.1 mIU/L (normal). Missed doses cause next-day sluggishness. Uses pill organizer to stay on track. Osteoarthritis: Acetaminophen as needed for mild pain. Meloxicam 7.5 mg when joints are stiff (knees/hands), taken only as needed due to NSAID concerns. Doctor suggested glucosamine supplements; effect unclear.
